recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future build output reintroduces the .txt.html href; if that happens, fix the generator or current source that emits the Attachment.contentType link rather than historical release snapshots.
issue_request: FHIR-2874 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction for the FHIR-core datatypes page. It reported that the Attachment XML example link for "Mime type of the content, with charset etc." used the broken URL http://www.rfc-editor.org/bcp/bcp13.txt.html and requested changing it to http://www.rfc-editor.org/bcp/bcp13.txt.
initial_application: No tracked commit explicitly mentions FHIR-2874. Jira comments record that Grahame Grieve marked the issue "Already fixed" in October 2014, and the current Attachment spreadsheet source does not contain the broken URL.
additional_context: Attachment is an active datatype in source/fhir.ini. The current Attachment.contentType row in source/datatypes/attachment.xml uses the MimeType type and the same descriptive text from the Jira report without embedding the stale .txt.html href. Source search found no remaining bcp13.txt.html URL in active source, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting context.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source is already correct for FHIR-2874, so the combined branch received an empty no-change audit commit.
